title: Command & Conquer 3: Tiberium Wars
notes: Campaign achievements come from your save games (Vault never touches the game, which has online play). The game saves automatically between missions; saving during a mission helps too.

Skirmish achievements come from the replay the game saves after every game (Documents\Command and Conquer 3 Tiberium Wars\Replays). Replays do not record who won, so these are about playing, not winning. Games shorter than 3 minutes do not count.

testGuide.title: Play a campaign mission
testGuide.detail: Beat a GDI or Nod mission. When the game saves between missions, "GDI: First Victory" or "Nod: First Victory" should pop.

testGuide.title: Play a skirmish
testGuide.detail: Play a skirmish for at least 3 minutes, then quit. "Into Battle" should pop.
